_comment: Benchmark suites for bench/tools/run.py. kind=harness runs a bench/harness binary (nanobench; --filter/--epochs/--min-epoch-ms/--out); kind=timeline runs a custom tool that writes its own JSON. env values are passed through ("auto" = the binary's own default, e.g. thread ladder up to hardware concurrency).

baseline.description: Every design and reference on the micro scenarios (FINDINGS section 2)

fusion.description: Fusion: sequential vs fused vs hand-merged

fusion-exec.description: Fusion extension points: planners x executors

skirmish.description: Skirmish RTS: ms/tick per design with per-system counters

threads.description: Thread scaling on Skirmish (thread ladder up to hardware concurrency)

quick.description: Smoke run: correctness of the harness, not numbers

compare.description: Between-build comparisons (rotate.py): short enough to take many interleaved samples

standard.description: Everyday comparisons: every suite at the default sizes

reference.description: Dedicated hardware: more paired rounds, longer epochs, larger sizes
